column1: # The §13 coverage matrix: every mechanism PANIX implements, its MITRE
# ATT&CK technique as PANIX's own table gives it, and what unbidden must
# report when PANIX plants it with --default. panix-loop.sh reads this file.
# kinds    Entry kinds that count as detection, space-separated.
# source   ERE the entry's source path must match.
# flags    ERE one of the entry's flags must match, or - where PANIX changes a
#          file a package ships in a way no manifest records (a mode bit, a
#          capability) and so no provenance flag can apply.
# marker   A string that must appear in the entry's command, notes, source file
#          or target file, tying the entry to the payload PANIX planted: the
#          callback port every planted payload dials. - where the mechanism
#          carries no payload of its own.
# A row whose kinds is OUT_OF_SCOPE is a tracked gap, with the reason and the
# section of the spec that makes it one. Adding a module to PANIX without
# adding a row here fails the loop.
